name: need
title: Need
description: What one person wants, in their own words. The atom: every other object is placed on the map by the needs it serves. A page speaks to several; each distinct one is its own entry, never one entry that summarises the page, and every one is traceable to a statement in the content. Granular: one entry for each thing a person could come to this page to get done, each step they take, each question it answers and each condition it sets. A product page holds five to ten; one entry that stands for the page is wrong. Each is a need someone brings to {{ identity.organisation.name }}, whose purpose is {{ identity.purpose.statement }}: write it as the thing that person wants from that organisation, in their words.

files.api/service.yaml:
# THE NEED'S PUBLIC FUNCTIONS (docs/unoverse/data/objects/README.md 4b). Every object extends need,
# so what is declared here is what every row can be asked unless its own object says otherwise: a
# document reads its file, a table its rows, a product its bodyCopy; the rest answer with the row.
#
#   getDetail    the row in full: every field the lean search result left out

getDetail:
  description: >-
    The row in full: every field the lean search result left out. A need's detail is its row,
    so nothing is fetched.
  returns: "{{ row }}"
files.need.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# THE ATOM. What one person wants, in their own words, and who that person is (audience:
# customer, employee, partner). Extracted from content, many per page. Every other object extends it (owner ruling 2026-09-08): a need's fields are what
# every row carries, and an object adds only what is its own.
type: object
name: need
# THE GLYPH its rows are drawn with (README 4a): a lucide icon name.
icon: target
uniqueBy: [title, description]   # what the id is minted from; thousands of needs share a title across pages
embed: [title, description, key_need, related_needs, questions, callToAction]   # the one field set every positioned object embeds on
search: [universal_id, object_type, title, description, key_need, action, app, source_url, source_id]   # the rest comes with getDetail
meta: open                       # anything else a writer puts in metadata rides along, undeclared

# THE FACE, as a node's node.yaml carries it: what this is and when an Agent reaches for it.
title: Need
description: >-
  What one person wants, in their own words. The atom: every other object is placed on the
  map by the needs it serves. A page speaks to several; each distinct one is its own entry,
  never one entry that summarises the page, and every one is traceable to a statement in the
  content. Granular: one entry for each thing a person could come to this page to get done,
  each step they take, each question it answers and each condition it sets. A product page
  holds five to ten; one entry that stands for the page is wrong. Each is a need someone
  brings to {{ identity.organisation.name }}, whose purpose is {{ identity.purpose.statement }}:
  write it as the thing that person wants from that organisation, in their words.
whenToUse: >-
  I want to get something done. I have a question. What can I do here? What do I need to know?
category: Objects
version: 1.0.0

props: { $include: props }
files.props.yaml:
# THE ATOM'S FIELDS, AND THE COMMON BLOCK EVERY OBJECT INHERITS (docs/unoverse/data/objects/README.md
# section 5): every object extends need, so every row carries these. Field names are the row's
# names as stored: columns snake_case, metadata keys camelCase. `input: true` is filled from
# outside the engine (an extraction, a promotion, an author); `input: false` is the engine's.
universal_id:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The row's permanent handle, assigned by the engine when the row is first written. Never changes.
org:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The organisation whose row this is. Assigned by the run.
source_url:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The page or record this row was extracted or promoted from. Assigned by the engine.
source_id:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The source record this row came from. Assigned by the engine.
llmObjectType:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    The model's own specific word for what this is, such as 'apprenticeship programme' or
    'complaint handling'. Never a generic kind word. Kept on the row's metadata and used as
    the prefix of its embedding text.
  maxLength: 60
title:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    The outcome, as a verb phrase with no person in it: 'Keep a message confidential', 'Earn
    cashback with a Visa credit card'. Never 'I', 'my', 'we' or 'our'; who has the need is
    the audience field. Never the organisation's name ({{identity.organisation.name}}), and
    never its internal label for the thing.
  maxLength: 120
audience:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    Who has this need, in one or two words: customer, employee, partner, applicant, a named
    business unit. Read it from the content and from who {{identity.organisation.name}}
    serves ({{identity.brand.positioning}}); a public page is for its customers unless the
    content says otherwise.
  maxLength: 40
description:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    The need itself, said plainly, with no person in it: no 'you', 'I', 'we', 'customers' or
    'the bank'; who has the need is the audience field. Three sentences: what is wanted, what
    is on offer for it, and what makes it work, with the real figures, terms and conditions.
    Like this: 'Building a home on land already owned. The construction is financed in stages
    as the work progresses, under a Shariah-compliant Tawarruq structure, and repaid in fixed
    monthly instalments over up to 25 years. Available to REDF and Ministry of Housing
    beneficiaries.' Not a word about the page, what it highlights or how it presents things:
    never 'the page', 'the content', 'is presented', 'states', 'the product provides'.
    Specific to what {{identity.organisation.name}} offers, never generic.
  minLength: 150
  maxLength: 700
key_need:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: >-
    The one need this answers, in one line, with no person in it: 'Finance for building a home on
    owned land', never 'I want' or 'you can'. It anchors the row on the map.
  maxLength: 160
related_needs:
  type: array
  input: true
  description: >-
    The smaller goals inside this one need, each a short verb phrase in the title's style
    with no person in it: 'Confirm investment-team capacity', 'Review planned hiring needs'.
    Each names its subject, so it reads on its own: 'Escalate an unresolved valet complaint',
    never 'Escalate unresolved concerns'. A phrase that could sit on any page of the site is
    not one. Only what sits inside this need. A goal a person could come for on its own is
    its own need entry, never a line here.
  minItems: 2
  maxItems: 7
  items:
    type: string
    maxLength: 160
questions:
  type: array
  input: true
  description: >-
    The questions this answers, each self-contained: it names the subject, so it reads
    without the page around it. Only what the content actually answers.
  minItems: 2
  maxItems: 4
  items:
    type: string
    maxLength: 160
callToAction:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: The sentence behind the button, written to the audience. The page's own where it has one.
  maxLength: 160
action:
  type: string
  input: true
  description: The button label, one to three words, drawn from the call to action.
  maxLength: 24

# ── THE DOOR (owner, 2026-09-11: any object may name the interface its rows wear, and every
# object extends need, so the field is declared once, here) ───────────────────────────────
app:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    The interface this row arrives on screen wearing, as unoverse://components/<org>/<name>.
    Stamped from the object's envelope at save, or assigned when a person picks the card.
